issue.scope: Baseline-backed evaluation of H1/H2 using committed corpus and committed evidence only.

artifact_status.name: behavioral_corpus
artifact_status.note: Committed frozen corpus with labeled expected targets/tests/AC ids.

artifact_status.name: toon_benchmark
artifact_status.note: Measures TOON serialization on survey artifacts, not adaptive-vs-full context packs on the issue #208 frozen corpus.

artifact_status.name: measure_verbs_report
artifact_status.note: Measures isolated ask-verb latency on a minimal fixture, not full-vs-incremental causal-cone refresh p95 on the issue #208 corpus.

hypotheses.statement: Adaptive context packs reduce serialized tokens by at least 30% versus the full snapshot while keeping task pass rate within 2 percentage points of baseline.
hypotheses.note: The committed corpus labels tasks, targets, tests, and AC ids, but does not commit paired baseline/candidate metric runs for this hypothesis.

hypotheses.statement: For local changes, incremental work grows with the affected causal cone rather than repository size, and cuts p95 by at least 3x on the frozen corpus.
hypotheses.note: The committed corpus labels tasks, targets, tests, and AC ids, but does not commit paired baseline/candidate metric runs for this hypothesis.

negative_findings: No committed paired baseline/candidate token measurements exist for adaptive-vs-full context packs.
No committed task pass-rate baseline exists for the issue #208 frozen corpus.
No committed full-scan vs incremental p95 measurements exist for local-change causal-cone refresh on this corpus.
No committed bytes-read/files-parsed/nodes-recomputed counters are attached to the issue #208 corpus cases.
